predecessors.name: Kingdom of Greece
predecessors.text: the Greek state taken over by the colonels' coup of 21 April 1967

successors.name: Third Hellenic Republic
successors.text: the whole Greek state after the regime fell on 24 July 1974

ledger.x: 1967: a group of right-wing army officers seizes power on 21 April.
1973: Papadopoulos 'abolished the monarchy and declared Greece a republic' on 1 June.

wars.name: Turkish invasion of Cyprus
wars.outcome: The junta-backed National Guard coup of 15 July 1974 against Makarios led to the Turkish landing of 20 July; 'On 23 July 1974 the Greek military junta collapsed mainly because of the events in Cyprus' and Karamanlis was sworn in as Prime Minister on 24 July.

certainty.note: Greece's land frontiers were treaty lines before the coup; the pages opened record no change in 1967-74.
